message: The other night, I realized I hadn’t checked our smoke alarms in a while, so I decided to make a little family event out of it. I called everyone into the kitchen, and we took turns pushing the test button, which turned into a laughter-filled moment as my youngest tried to mimic the beeping sound. Afterward, we chatted about our escape plan and even practiced a little drill—who knew safety could be so entertaining? Have you ever turned a safety task into a fun family moment?
